admission.justification: Two owners must agree: the layout owner decides which rows a store holds and the discovery walk decides which stores and receipts are examined at all. A census built from the delivery queue would silently drop a message that is still held, and the discovery and authority cases pin the retention and the incomplete-read boundaries that prevent it.

applicability: Warm per-store held-message retention and publication within the authority reader's retained targets, admitted authority rows and served held rows.
conditions: The delivery queue is a visit order, never a census; a store the queue does not mention is still reached through bounded discovery.
While its target and rows remain retained and admitted, a store that cannot be read whole preserves its own last complete rows rather than replacing them with a malformed subset.

The authority publishes at most its newest 256 rows and retains at most 1024 targets; the serving reader publishes only the first 128 authority rows. Overflow or target shedding can remove an occurrence without delivery or withdrawal. Authority overflow or shedding contributes incompleteness; the additional served-row slice sets no separate cap-completeness flag. Neither omission is native clearing evidence.
exclusions: Treating an unreadable or partly enumerated store as an empty one.
Message body, attachment contents or any rendering of message text.
Producing, retrying, holding or withdrawing a message.
Unlimited retention or visibility under authority, retained-target or served-row saturation.

evidence: notes/reports/reviewer/267804e5-dd71-51e8-8f1d-d975effaaeaf/role-launch/round4/L190-fix-verification-R4.json#L190-R1-F02; Any incomplete warm store retains its prior rows, including a nonempty malformed subset; complete later reads remain the only clearing authority. Exact warm A+B -> valid A plus malformed sibling regression fails on before source and passes on candidate. Previous queue/rotation fixes retained.

statement: Within the retained store and admitted authority/served populations, a warm held occurrence survives incomplete reads of its own store; complete native delivery or withdrawal evidence ends it, while bounded shedding or publication omission can remove it without proving its native end.
